meta.title: BlokMate | Digital Ease for Building Management
meta.description: BlokMate brings dues tracking, collection, announcements and maintenance requests into one dashboard for apartment and site managers.

hero.badge: A Digital Platform for Building Management
hero.subtitle: Dues tracking, collection, announcements and maintenance requests — no more scattered spreadsheets. One dashboard, real-time, built to make a manager's life easier.

howItWorks.title: A 5-minute setup
howItWorks.subtitle: Add your building, invite residents, start tracking dues.

steps.title: Add your building
steps.desc: Import your building, unit and resident data in one go — spreadsheet import supported.

steps.title: Set up your dues cycle
steps.desc: Set the monthly amount, due date and reminder rules — the system handles the rest automatically.

steps.title: Start managing
steps.desc: Residents pay in one tap, you track announcements and maintenance requests from a single dashboard.

features.title: A real fix for what turns building management into a burden
features.subtitle: Designed around what managers actually need.

items.title: Dues tracking & collection
items.desc: See who's paid and who owes at a glance. Automatic reminders raise your collection rate.

items.title: One-tap payment
items.desc: Residents pay their dues in seconds via bank transfer, card or online payment.

items.title: Announcements & notifications
items.desc: Building-wide announcements reach every resident instantly — say goodbye to the paper notice board.

items.title: Maintenance & ticket management
items.desc: Residents report issues, you track and close them — nothing falls through the cracks.

items.title: Switch from Excel in 5 minutes
items.desc: Import your existing records — no starting from scratch.

items.title: Secure by design
items.desc: Your data is stored encrypted, accessible only to authorized people.

pricing.title: Simple pricing that fits your building's size
pricing.subtitle: No hidden fees — an exact quote after a short call.

demo.title: See BlokMate in 60 seconds
demo.subtitle: From dues tracking to collection, announcements to maintenance — the whole flow in one video.

onboarding.title: Welcome to BlokMate

onboarding.step2: Dues, announcements, payments and reports — BlokMate's four core features lighten your management workload.
